Public expenditure on low-carbon energy-related research and development (R&D) reached an all-time
high in 2024 (Figure 3.14). While China was a key driver of growth in public R&D spending between 2018
and 2023, Europe emerged as the leading contributor to the increase in 2024. R&D expenditure in Japan,
Korea, Australia and New Zealand also increased slightly in 2024 after having fallen in 2023.
